summary: Published the 0.3.0 stable release from the reviewed commit through the protected GitHub Actions workflow; all five package versions and the clean release validation passed.

evidence.description: 0.3.0 changelog with delivered DS-1 through DS-6 capabilities and compatibility requirements.
Release and GitHub Packages publication procedure updated for v0.3.0.
Five 0.3.0 package tarballs validated by publish:check.
Protected publication workflow completed successfully for tag v0.3.0.

validation.command: . $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.3 && corepack yarn install --immutable && corepack yarn verify && corepack yarn pack:local && corepack yarn publish:check --tag v0.3.0 --skip-registry && git diff --check
validation.details: Node 22.22.3 was selected with nvm. Full verify passed, including all workspace builds/checks/tests and both Storybook builds; five 0.3.0 tarballs and publication metadata passed locally. The protected workflow then validated and published all five packages successfully.

limitations: The packages remain private on GitHub Packages until an organization administrator changes visibility; this is intentional and documented.
